dedupe_keys.name: hydrogeological model for the island of norderney germany

description: The University of Oldenburg publishes a three-dimensional hydrogeological model of Norderney island in Germany. The Zenodo record supplies GemPy voxel-model outputs and parameter settings, discretisation information, GeoTIFF layer bases and thicknesses, CSV tables, figure scripts and the processing workflow. Separate ZIP archives organise these components. The repository documents Python 3.9.13, R 4.2.1, GemPy 2.2.11 and QGIS 3.20.1 as required software. The model and workflow are openly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. This is a static geological representation of one island; the metadata does not state a universal spatial resolution or a time-varying flow solution. Numerical grid dimensions and individual parameter values were not checked inside the archives. Water-supply modellers could use the layer geometry and documented construction route as inputs to a separate groundwater or freshwater-lens simulation. Geological interpolation and local source coverage limit transfer to other islands. The resource complements observation-based groundwater datasets with an explicit subsurface geometry; it is not a ready water-distribution network model.
